name: testimonial-vertical-marquee
title: Testimonial Vertical Marquee
description: Columns of testimonial cards scrolling up and down inside a masked window. Built on Marquee; still under reduced motion.

props.name: title
props.description: The section headline. Labels the section for assistive tech.

props.name: items
props.type: { id: string; quote: string; name: string; role?: string; company?: string }[]
props.description: Testimonials, dealt out to the columns in turn.

props.name: columns
props.description: Number of columns on wide containers. Narrow ones show fewer.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for one full loop of the first column.

props.name: pauseOnHover
props.description: Pause a column while the pointer or focus is on it.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Stops every column and shows the cards still.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root element.
